decisions.relation: OHM boundary=administrative + admin_level=2 relations are imported as "administers" (de facto administration). OHM does not distinguish de facto control from de jure sovereignty, so no sovereignty claim is imported. Labelled "per OpenHistoricalMap".
decisions.end_date: OHM end_date is read as the first day the boundary no longer applied: OHM chains successive boundaries with the same date as one end_date and the next start_date. On a changeover day we show the successor. (OHM's own viewer shows both on that day.)
decisions.no_end_date: A relation without end_date is imported with end "ongoing".
decisions.edtf_tags: Where start_date:edtf or end_date:edtf exist, they are used instead of start_date/end_date.
decisions.polities: Relations are grouped into one polity by their Wikidata ID, or by English name when there is none. Polity IDs are permanent and recorded in polity-ids.json.
decisions.names: The name and name:<language> tags of each relation are copied, with the dates of the relations that carry them. Tagged "name" without a language is recorded as lang "und" (the local name).
decisions.geometry: Each OHM way is simplified once (Douglas–Peucker, 0.005°), so shared borders stay aligned; rings are then assembled, trimmed to the import areas whose box they reach and whose years they overlap, and rounded to 4 decimal places. Edge precision is "unknown" because OHM doesn't record it.
decisions.coverage: No coverage is asserted: OHM does not claim to be complete, so land with no imported boundary is shown as "no data", never as "no state".
decisions.bce: This import contains no BCE dates. OHM's convention for negative years has not been verified yet.
